title: pool build --ask and --redo make a run-<pid>-<hex> scratch directory in sonnet_regexes that nothing removes, since no Bench closes it
goal: bench_pool.sonnet_regexes runs its Sonnet call in a temporary directory that is removed after the call, so a paid pool build leaves no scratch directory

run: import sys,re;t=open("_tools/bench_pool.py",encoding="utf-8").read();i=t.find("def sonnet_regexes");j=t.find("\ndef ",i+10);sys.exit(1 if "scratch_dir()" in t[i:j] else 0)

repro_reason: the call is a paid Sonnet run, so the repro reads that sonnet_regexes still takes scratch_dir() from the benchmarks scratch base
